narrative.overview: Home is a bright card-shop counter scene for deciding about exact singles. Warm bench, paper, ink, and orange tokens frame direct local search, image-backed identity, evidence slips, honest estimate freshness, and one clear value-details action. The decision-world is scoped to Home; archive-world remains the card-detail contract.
keyCharacteristics: Square rules and warm bench/paper/ink/orange palette.
Barlow Condensed action hierarchy with Azeret Mono evidence only.
Accessible mode switch, direct local search, visible methodology, honest unavailable Sealed mode, and one reveal motion with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Keep the decision-world on Home and preserve archive-world for card detail; do not merge their visual contracts.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Show exact identity, discriminators, source/methodology, and current/fresh, stale, or unpriced status without fabricated precision.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Make search and one value-details action clear, with 44px-class touch targets and keyboard focus.

dos: Do keep Singles as the default Home mode and state Sealed honestly unavailable.
Do use square geometry, warm bench/paper/ink/orange tokens, and evidence slips.
Do preserve the archive-world contract on card detail.
Do keep methodology, disclaimer, freshness, and unpriced evidence visible.
Do provide one bench-reveal motion and disable it for reduced motion.
donts: Don't imply sealed, trade, seller-count, language, condition, finish, or Poland-shipping capability.
Don't hide stale or unpriced estimates behind decorative treatment.
Don't replace either scoped world with generic rounded marketplace cards, glass, or gradients.
